title: Repeat Guarantee Claims — Share of the Shortfall Paid
content:
**Clause (Plus guarantee, Northgate Memberships).** Guarantee refunds already paid on the membership in the 36 months before the claim set the repeat-claim share: two or more earlier guarantee refunds give a share of one half, one earlier guarantee refund gives a share of three quarters, and none gives the whole shortfall. The claim pays the guarantee shortfall multiplied by the repeat-claim share.

**Counting.** Earlier guarantee refunds are the guarantee refund entries on the membership's ledger whose date lies fewer than 36 whole months before the claim.

| Earlier guarantee refunds in the 36 months before the claim | Repeat-claim share | Share as a figure |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | one half | 0.5 |
| exactly 1 | three quarters | 0.75 |
| none | the whole shortfall | 1 |

## Hypothetical cases (guarantee shortfall of 24.00)

| Earlier guarantee refunds | Share | Shortfall paid |
|---|---|---|
| none | whole | 24.00 |
| one, paid 20 whole months before | three quarters | 18.00 |
| two, paid 11 and 23 whole months before | one half | 12.00 |
| one, paid 36 whole months before | outside the 36 months: whole | 24.00 |
